entities.name: Jherana Rure
entities.description: Commander of the Order of the Ebon Hand on Sarpadia who led the counterinsurgency against the thrulls.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Creatures created by Endrek Sahr who rose against their masters.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Whose visit made thrulls more self-confident.

events.summary: Intelligent thrulls turned the species against their masters, and Jherana Rure took command of the counterinsurgency.
events.quote: Jherana Rure became the commander of the counterinsurgency against the thrull army.

events.summary: Jherana Rure was killed by Necrites, ending the counterinsurgency.
events.quote: She was eventually killed by Necrites, ending the counterinsurgency in a single blow.

relations.note: He created the thrulls of Sarpadia.
relations.quote: the Thrulls of Sarpadia - created by Endrek Sahr
